messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.52
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.52) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

The main change is to checkAlleles(), to deal with the case that pairwise linkage results were derived from markerlrt().

Karl Broman
